summary: The compact gabled silhouette, raised base, and three-step entry make a coherent miniature, but key appearance and side-window details conflict with the reference.

orientation.summary: SV1 is located southwest of the studio and geometrically faces the +u and +v sides. It shows the principal door on the right-hand gable, supporting the southeast-facing +u end. The four-face sheet places the sole rendered door on +u, the actual inventory confirms one +u door at bearing 145°, and -u is blank; therefore the principal-entry orientation is correct and not duplicated.

issues.problem: The reddish-brown walls read as masonry/brick, whereas SV1 shows timber siding, changing the studio’s characteristic appearance.
issues.fix: Replace the brick pattern with simplified reddish-brown horizontal or shingle-like timber cladding.

issues.problem: SV1 places the tall side window on the southwest +v wall, but the four-face sheet shows it on the northeast -v wall, mirroring this characteristic feature.
issues.fix: Move the tall white-trimmed window from -v to +v, near the +u entrance end.

issues.problem: The model uses strongly articulated gray shingles, while the reference has a pale, lightly seamed metal roof with modest eaves.
issues.fix: Use a smoother pale metal-roof treatment with subtle seams and restrained overhangs.
